metadata.name: AuthorizationIntegrationApi
metadata.description: This webhook is triggered when  transaction perform on card.

request_fields.name: user_id
request_fields.description: Userid provided by Corecard to use the  API Allowable Values: 128

request_fields.name: password
request_fields.description: Password provided by Corecard to use the API Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: request_id
request_fields.description: CoreCard system’s Unique id of transaction (Tranid) Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: admin_number
request_fields.description: Corecard system’s Value which can be used as Proxy to card number. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: last4_card_number
request_fields.description: Card number’s last 4 digits Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: transaction_amount
request_fields.description: Amount of Transaction (DE4 of Authorization request in case Domestic Transaction and De5 in case of International Transaction)

request_fields.name: post_time
request_fields.description:
CoreCard system’s Posting time of transaction 
Format:(mmddyyyyhhmmss) Allowable Values: 14

request_fields.name: local_tran_time
request_fields.description:
Local time of transaction where its originated. 
(De12/13 of Authorization request)
Format: MMDDYYYYhhmmss Allowable Values: 14

request_fields.name: Transmission_Date_Time
request_fields.description:
Transmission date time of Network.
(MC send us UTC Time) 
(Format: MMDDYYYYhhnnss) 
DE 7 of the Authorization requests Allowable Values: 14

request_fields.name: local_currencycode
request_fields.description:
Local Transaction Currency code (Transaction Currency Code) De49 of Authorization Message
Example – USD Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: Local_Transaction_Amount
request_fields.description:
Transaction amount in Local Currency(De 4 In case of cross border or international transaction)
Example – 200.8000
Condition: Will be available if present in request. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Issuer_Currency_Code
request_fields.description:
Primary Currency code of the Product.
Example – USD Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: Transaction_Time_Zone
request_fields.description:
Local Transaction Time Zone 
Time zone where the transaction was attempted.
Will be populated only in case of multiple time zone support is turned on.
Example – ZoneCode1 or ZoneCode2 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: Time_Zone_Country_Name
request_fields.description:
Country Name where transaction was attempted.
 Will be populated only in case of multiple time zone support is turned on. Allowable Values: 70

request_fields.name: Time_Zone_Olson
request_fields.description:
Timezone in olson format.      
Will be populated only in case of multiple time zone support is turned on.
Example: America/New_York, America/Costa_Rica Allowable Values: 70

request_fields.name: Time_Zone_Details
request_fields.description:
Time Zone Name.   
Will be populated only in case of multiple time zone support is turned on.
Example: EST / PST / IST Allowable Values: 200

request_fields.name: Time_Zone_Value
request_fields.description:
Time denotation of Time zone where transaction was attempted.    
Will be populated only in case of multiple time zone support is turned on.
Example:  UTC/DST Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: merchant_category_code
